title: Applied Sociolinguistic AI for Community Development (ASA-CD): A New Scientific Paradigm for Linguistically-Grounded Community Problem-Solving

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing digital discourse and community dialogues for 'linguistic biomarkers' of social distance and fragmentation, specifically measuring the frequency of exclusive pronouns (e.g., 'they', 'them'), generalising syntax, and the absence of inclusive cross-group references (e.g., 'we', 'us') to evaluate out-group framing and social cohesion.
